entries.name: net-snmp
entries.description: A suite of software for using and deploying the SNMP protocol (v1, v2c and v3 and the AgentX subagent protocol). Contains also Python bindings.

entries.name: SNMP++
entries.description: BSD licensed SNMP implemention from HP. Supports SNMP v1/2c/v3, thread-safety, and many more.

entries.name: AGENT++
entries.description: The AGENT++ C++ framework provides a complete tri-lingual SNMP v1/2c/3 protocol engine and dispatcher for the development of SNMP agents. Apache licensed.

entries.name: AgentX++
entries.description: The AgentX++ C++ framework provides a complete AgentX protocol (RFC 2741) implementation that adds AgentX master and sub-agent support to AGENT++ (Commercial).

entries.name: openSNMP
entries.description: BSD licensed multi-threaded implementation of SNMPv3.

entries.name: C# SNMP Library
entries.description: MIT licensed SNMP library for .NET with extensive SNMP standard support, latest .NET platform targets, as well as rich manager/agent samples.

entries.name: SNMP Pro
entries.description: Commercial extension that adds enterprise MIB support.

entries.name: SnmpSharpNet
entries.description: Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) .Net library written in C# (csharp). Implements protocol version 1, 2 and 3.

entries.name: Erlang/OTP SNMP
entries.description: SNMP development is included as a component of the Erlang/Open Telecom Platform development environment.

entries.name: gosnmp/gosnmp
entries.description: An SNMP library written in Go. It provides Get, GetNext, GetBulk, Walk, BulkWalk, Set and Traps. It supports IPv4/IPv6, using SNMP v1/v2c/v3.

entries.name: sleepinggenius2/gosmi
entries.description: MIB parser in Go language.

entries.name: posteo/go-agentx
entries.description: A library with a pure Go implementation of the AgentX-Protocol.

entries.name: SNMP4J
entries.description: SNMP4J is an enterprise class, free open source, and state-of-the-art SNMP v1/2c/v3 implementation for Java™.

entries.name: SNMP4J-Agent
entries.description: SNMP4J-Agent is a Java™ API on top of the core SNMP4J API for the development of SNMP agents (command responders).

entries.name: joeSNMP
entries.description: joeSNMP is an open-source Java SNMP class library published under the LGPL.

entries.name: Westhawk's SNMP
entries.description: An open-sourced Java library that can be used for SNMP v1/v2c/v3. Supports traps, authentication and privacy. As authentication protocols it offers MD5 and SHA1.

entries.name: mibble
entries.description: Mibble is an open-source SNMP MIB (or SMI) parser library for Java.

entries.name: node-net-snmp
entries.description: JavaScript implementation of the Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP), implements versions 1, 2c and 3.

entries.name: node-snmp-native
entries.description: Native JavaScript SNMP library for Node.js.

entries.name: node-snmpjs
entries.description: This package provides a toolkit for SNMP agents and management applications in Node.js.

entries.name: snmp-node
entries.description: Native JavaScript SNMP library for Node.js.

entries.name: luasnmp
entries.description: Lua binding to net-snmp library.

entries.name: php.net/SNMP
entries.description: This is an SNMP extension for PHP, which is a wrapper around the net-snmp library.

entries.name: FreeDSx/SNMP
entries.description: A Pure PHP SNMP Library.

entries.name: opensolutions/OSS_SNMP
entries.description: A PHP SNMP library for people who hate SNMP, MIBs and OIDs!

entries.name: pysnmp
entries.description: This is a pure-Python, open source and free implementation of v1/v2c/v3 SNMP engine distributed under 2-clause BSD license.

entries.name: pysmi
entries.description: PySMI is a pure-Python implementation of SNMP SMI MIB parser.

entries.name: gufo_snmp
entries.description: The accelerated Python SNMP client library supporting both async and synchronous mode. It consists of a clean Python API for high-efficient BER parser and socket IO, implemented in the Rust language with PyO3 wrapper. Seems to be a bit early in the project's lifecycle, but it is easy to use and extremely fast, especially when querying many devices.

entries.name: net-snmp Python bindings
entries.description: Net-SNMP 5.4 and later contains Python bindings in the "python" sub-directory, though, they are not built by default.

entries.name: easysnmp
entries.description: A fork of net-snmp Python bindings that attempts to bring a more Pythonic interface to the library.

entries.name: puresnmp
entries.description: Pure Python3 SNMPv2 library without any dependencies.

entries.name: snimpy
entries.description: Snimpy is a Python-based tool providing a simple interface to build SNMP query.

entries.name: python-netsnmpagent
entries.description: This package allows to write net-snmp subagents in Python.

entries.name: hnmp
entries.description: HNMP is a high-level Python library to ease the pain of retrieving and processing data from SNMP-capable devices such as network switches, routers, and printers.

entries.name: aiosnmp
entries.description: Python package aiosnmp is an asynchronous SNMP client for use with asyncio. Only SNMP v2c is supported.

entries.name: robotframework-snmplibrary
entries.description: SNMPLibrary is a Robot Framework test library for testing SNMP.

entries.name: Scapy
entries.description: Packet manipulation program & library. Scapy has a module to build/dissect SNMP packets.

entries.name: ruby-netsnmp
entries.description: SNMP library in ruby (v1, v2c, v3).

entries.name: snmp-parser
entries.description: SNMP parser written in rust with nom parser combinator framework.

entries.name: davedufresne/modern_snmp
entries.description: Modern SNMP is a pure-Rust library for SNMPv3. This repository includes snmp_mp (SNMPv3 Message Processing) and snmp_usm (Implementation of the User-based Security Model (USM) for SNMPv3) crates.

entries.name: Svedrin/sunt
entries.description: This repository implements an SNMP Agent written in Rust.

entries.name: encode_keychange
entries.description: Produces the KeyChange string for SNMPv3.

entries.name: snmptranslate
entries.description: Translates MIB OID names between numeric and textual forms.

entries.name: snmpget
entries.description: Communicates with a network entity using SNMP GET requests.

entries.name: snmpgetnext
entries.description: Communicates with a network entity using SNMP GETNEXT requests.

entries.name: snmpbulkget
entries.description: Communicates with a network entity using SNMP GETBULK requests.

entries.name: snmpwalk
entries.description: Retrieves a subtree of management values using SNMP GETNEXT requests.

entries.name: snmpbulkwalk
entries.description: Retrieves a subtree of management values using SNMP GETBULK requests.

entries.name: snmpset
entries.description: Communicates with a network entity using SNMP SET requests.

entries.name: snmptest
entries.description: Communicates with a network entity using SNMP requests.

entries.name: snmptable
entries.description: Retrieve an SNMP table and display it in tabular form.

entries.name: snmpdelta
entries.description: Monitor delta differences in SNMP Counter values.

entries.name: snmpusm
entries.description: Manipulates the SNMPv3 User-based-security user table.

entries.name: snmpvacm
entries.description: Manipulates the SNMPv3 View-based-access-control-module configuration tables.

entries.name: snmpstatus
entries.description: Retrieves a fixed set of management information from a network entity.

entries.name: snmpnetstat
entries.description: Display networking status and configuration information from a network entity via SNMP.

entries.name: snmpdf
entries.description: Displays disk information like the unix df tool using information collected from SNMP.

entries.name: snmptrap
entries.description: Sends SNMP TRAP or INFORM notification messages.

entries.name: snmptrapd
entries.description: An SNMP daemon that listens for SNMP TRAPs or INFORMs and logs or acts upon them.

entries.name: traptoemail
entries.description: This an snmptrapd handler script to convert snmp traps into emails.

entries.name: net-snmp-config
entries.description: Returns information about installed net-snmp libraries and binaries.

entries.name: snmpconf
entries.description: Creates and modifies SNMP configuration files.

entries.name: fixproc
entries.description: Fixes a process by performing the specified action.

entries.name: snmpd
entries.description: An SNMP agent that responds to SNMP requests for a given host.

entries.name: mib2c
entries.description: A MIB conversion utility that can translate MIB structures into other forms, such as C-code.

entries.name: mib2c-update
entries.description: This a script to merge custom code into updated mib2c code.

entries.name: SNMP4JCLT
entries.description: Use the SNMP4J Command Line Tool (CLT) to send SNMPv1/v2c/v3 requests and traps to a target with IPv4 or v6 based UDP, TCP, or TLSv1,2 transport (Commercial).

entries.name: smilint
entries.description: This is used to check MIB or PIB modules for syntax errors and semantics at some degree. SMIv1/v2 style MIB modules as well as SPPI PIB modules are supported.

entries.name: smidump
entries.description: This is a MIB/PIB compiler. It allows to dump the contents of a module in various formats: SMIv1, SMIv2, SMIng, SPPI, Import Trees, Type Definition Trees, OID Node Trees, MOSY Style, and CORBA IDL definitions according to the JIDM Specs, and others.

entries.name: smidiff
entries.description: This is a tool that parses two revisions of a MIB module and analyzes the modifications from the old to the new revision.

entries.name: smiquery
entries.description: This is a MIB/PIB query front end. It can be used to query single items from the command line.

entries.name: smistrip
entries.description: This is a simple shell/awk script that allows to extract MIB and PIB modules from documents, such as RFCs or Internet Drafts.

entries.name: libsmi tools
entries.description: Applications built on top of libsmi and an sh/awk script that are integrated with the libsmi distribution.

entries.name: snmpsim
entries.description: This is a pure-Python, open source and free implementation of SNMP agents simulator distributed under 2-clause BSD license.

entries.name: snmpfwd
entries.description: The SNMP Proxy Forwarder tool works as an application-level proxy with a built-in SNMP message router. Typical use case for an SNMP proxy is to work as an application-level firewall or a protocol translator that enables SNMPv3 access to a SNMPv1/SNMPv2c entity or vice versa.

entries.name: snmpclitools
entries.description: This is a collection of command-line SNMP tools written in pure-Python. The tools mimic their famous Net-SNMP counterparts. It includes snmpget.py, snmpset.py, snmpwalk.py, snmpbulkwalk.py, snmptrap.py, and snmptranslate.py, see here for more details.

entries.name: snmpwn
entries.description: SNMPwn is an SNMPv3 user enumerator and attack tool.

entries.name: trapperkeeper
entries.description: A suite of tools for ingesting and displaying SNMP traps. This is designed as a replacement for snmptrapd and to supplement existing stateful monitoring solutions.

entries.name: snmptt
entries.description: SNMPTT (SNMP Trap Translator) is an SNMP trap handler written in Perl for use with the Net-SNMP / UCD-SNMP snmptrapd program (www.net-snmp.org). SNMPTT supports Linux, Unix and Windows.

entries.name: snmpttconvert
entries.description: Some vendors provide a file that can be imported into HP Openview using a HP Openview utility. snmpttconvert is a simple Perl script which will convert one of these files into the format used by snmptt.

entries.name: snmpttconvertmib
entries.description: The snmpttconvertmib is a Perl script which will read a MIB file and convert the TRAP-TYPE (v1) or NOTIFICATION-TYPE (v2) definitions into a configuration file readable by snmptt.

entries.name: SNMP Trap Translator
entries.description: SNMPTT (SNMP Trap Translator) is an SNMP trap handler written in Perl for use with the Net-SNMP / UCD-SNMP snmptrapd program (www.net-snmp.org).

entries.name: prometheus/snmp_exporter
entries.description: This exporter is the recommended way to expose SNMP data in a format which Prometheus can ingest.

entries.name: trailofbits/onesixtyone
entries.description: Fast SNMP Scanner.

entries.name: SECFORCE/SNMP-Brute
entries.description: Fast SNMP brute force, enumeration, CISCO config downloader and password cracking script.

entries.name: zabbix-tools/mib2zabbix
entries.description: This Perl script will generate a Zabbix v3 Template in XML format from an OID tree in a SNMP MIB file.

entries.name: OIDrage
entries.description: A lightweight standalone SNMPd mimic server based on any snmpwalk output. Easily scales to mock thousands of servers.

entries.name: agentpp/MIB Designer
entries.description: Use MIB Designer to create, edit, manage, and explore SMI specifications (Commercial).

entries.name: agentpp/MIB Explorer Pro
entries.description: Use MIB Explorer to browse, configure, test&debug, monitor, and discover SNMPv1/2c/3 entities.

entries.name: sharpsnmp/SNMP Pro
entries.description: A family of modern SNMP products, featuring cross-platform MIB Designer/Compiler/Browser within VS Code, full v1/v2c/v3 coverage, MIB/SMI v1 and v2 support, as well as emulator and MCP bridge to AI tools. Commercial and open source .NET libraries are included too.

entries.name: paessler/snmptester
entries.description: This tool enables you to debug SNMP activities to find communication and/or data issues in SNMP monitoring configurations. Windows.

entries.name: ireasoning/MIB Browser
entries.description: This tool allows users to load standard, proprietary MIBs, and even some mal-formed MIBs. It also allows them to issue SNMP requests to retrieve agent's data, or make changes to the agent. Free for personal use.

entries.name: ireasoning/SNMP Agent Simulator
entries.description: Free SNMP Agent Simulator Java based application that can simulate SNMPv1/v2c/v3 agents.

entries.name: Visual SNMP
entries.description: Visual SNMP is a simple tool for testing access to SNMP agents. Currently SNMPGET and SNMPWALK are supported with some limited funcionality.

entries.name: muonics/Online MIB validator
entries.description: Free online MIB/PIB Validator based on MIB Smithy SDK.

entries.name: toni-moreno/snmpcollector
entries.description: SnmpCollector is a full featured Generic SNMP data collector with Web Administration Interface Open Source tool which has as main goal simplify the configuration for getting data from any device which snmp protocol support and send resulting data to an influxdb backend.

entries.name: Unbrowse SNMP
entries.description: Unbrowse SNMP is a tool that helps to compile cryptic MIB files into an easy GUI view, retrieve and set MIB variables on devices, import snmpwalk dumps, receive traps, chart counters, and much more.

entries.name: TWSNMP FK
entries.description: An ultra-lightweight SNMP manager for Windows and Mac OS, featuring network mapping, polling, and AI analysis.

entries.name: The Networknomicon, or SNMP Mastery by Abdul Alhazred and Michael W. Lucas
entries.description: The Simple Network Management Protocol, SNMP, empowers you to invoke ancient standards from the void. SNMP exposes the secrets of your network and servers, and--if you're careless--reconfigures them into unspeakable nightmares. It exposes your inadequate brain to the vast alien dimensions underlying modern computing.

entries.name: SNMP MIB Handbook by Larry Walsh
entries.description: Essential Guide to SNMP MIB Development, Use, and Diagnosis.

entries.name: Mauro, D. and Schmidt, K., 2005. Essential SNMP: Help for System and Network Administrators. " O'Reilly Media, Inc.".
entries.description: Essential SNMP explores both commercial and open source packages, and elements like OIDs, MIBs, community strings, and traps are covered in depth. The book contains five new chapters and various updates throughout.

entries.name: Snmp, Snmpv2, Snmpv3, and Rmon 1 and 2 by William Stallings
entries.description: Presents a concise, focused & practical guide to SNMP-based network & internetwork management for network administrators, managers, & designers.

entries.name: Perkins, D. and McGinnis, E., 1997. Understanding SNMP MIBs (p. 528). Englewood Cliffs: Prentice Hall PTR.
entries.description: The first complete, practical insider's guide to writing SNMP MIBs.

entries.description: mibDepot is a free service to the SNMP community and offers a dictionary of MIBs and a unique-in-the-industry Search Engine with over 12,000 SNMP MIBs representing over 1,800,000 MIB object definitions.

entries.description: This OID repository gathers information about Object Identifiers (OIDs), and provides tools to display, update and search for this information.

entries.description: This repository contains over 7000 unique MIBs from various vendors.

entries.name: SNMPTools.net
entries.description: SNMPTools.net provides links and information about SNMP applications, toolkits, gateways, simulators, MIB browsers and many more.
